dispatch: Serial seeds and processes; rotate arm order by (seed-42) modulo six; each process evaluates the three cases in the listed order. Core CPU/double, below-normal priority, nested parallelism suppressed.

powerAllocation.spacing: rigid lens shifts within original explicit axial windows and mechanical frame
powerAllocation.closure: assign and freeze front editable element powers with shared Core; leave last two editable lenses free; close original A/focal/pupil through existing Core-backed target solver; independently recheck powers and targets

armDefinitions.fixed: One existing-parent optimization branch, then shared competition and independent original validation; no structural proposal or power allocation.
armDefinitions.direct: Parent control plus six requested structural operations; short compensation and original validation, no explicit recovery or competition.
armDefinitions.recover: Same proposals plus fresh paraxial recovery, short compensation and original validation; no competition.
armDefinitions.compete: Same seven branches plus recovery and shared multi-round competition before original validation.
armDefinitions.power: Parent control plus one power-allocation/closure branch, short compensation and shared competition; no structural edits.
armDefinitions.combined: Seven structural/control branches plus one power-allocation branch, recovery, compensation and shared competition.

inputPolicy: Eight-element inputs are actual completed finalists from frozen M0/M1 off-seed42..46 results, selected deterministically by worst throughput then worst RMS. Original-half21 is the unchanged frozen original three-element SK4/SK4/LAK09 prescription. All arms for a case/seed receive identical inputs, apertures, materials, fixed planes, fields, wavelengths, original target and permissions.
permissions: Original expansion flags, protected elements, min/max element count and material/profile permissions remain authoritative. Eight-element fixtures cannot insert/split beyond the original maximum of eight. Original-half21 permits deletion only; forbidden edits are recorded and do not execute. No aperture enlargement, stop/image motion or extra asphere permission.
acquisitionAccounting: Frozen M0/M1 actual functions/gradients/rays/elapsed are subtracted from the eight-element unified limit and added back for end-to-end billing; no free preparation. The original-half21 input is user-provided and has zero search acquisition charge. M2 revalidates every parent independently and charges that work. Historical acquisition wall time is disclosed separately from current measured M2 time.
qualification: Only completed unchanged TopologyValidator original-spec CPU results qualify. Preserve existing qualified parents, distinguish newly changed prescriptions and structural reductions, and retain a separate complexity/quality Pareto frontier. Coarse or course results never qualify.
interpretation: Ninety bounded engineering runs, all seeds/failures/incomplete validations retained. Compare direct/recovery/competition and native-parent/power sources; failed construction is not a proof of infeasibility or a speed success. No Cooke/Tessar or native desktop certification.
